resources.string: The watch is not sending data. Check that the watch is on, nearby, and that SeizureGuard is running on it.
OSD is not receiving data. Check that OpenSeizureDetector is open and running.
OSD is not accepting watch data. In OpenSeizureDetector, set the data source to Garmin.
OSD rejected the watch data. Restart OpenSeizureDetector and check its data source is Garmin.
OpenSeizureDetector is open but not analysing the watch data. Open the app and check that its data source is Garmin.
The bridge could not start. Open SeizureGuard and allow the Nearby devices (Bluetooth) permission.
The phone restarted and the bridge could not start by itself. Tap here, then tap Start bridge.

SeizureGuard sends your watch data to OpenSeizureDetector (OSD).
Before starting: open OSD, set its data source to Garmin, and make sure OSD is running with its web server on.
Then tap Start bridge. You only need this screen to start or stop it.
Allow Nearby devices, or the bridge cannot start.
